buildCommand:
echo "SUPABASE_URL=$SUPABASE_URL
SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=$SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
TMDB_API_KEY=$TMDB_API_KEY
TMDB_BASE_URL=$TMDB_BASE_URL
TMDB_IMAGE_BASE=$TMDB_IMAGE_BASE" > .env && flutter/bin/flutter build web --release
installCommand: if [ ! -d flutter ]; then git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git -b stable --depth 1; fi && flutter/bin/flutter config --enable-web && flutter/bin/flutter pub get
